prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
System: Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper), 24/7 regional EMS dispatch; zones have primary/alternate routes to Emergency Department (ED, gets backup arrival updates) and Riverside Trauma Center. Center: creates incident record, preserves caller report, escalates readiness gaps, produces Unit Staging Change Card, records authorization time, unit-selection reason, routes and restriction rationale/scope/duration; keeps coverage picture; retains audit evidence under access/retention controls; reviews service measures against thresholds. Uses Battery Swap Voucher, North Approach Queue Snapshot, Caller Location Correction Slip. Modes: Surge (queue-age, high-priority-call or staffing thresholds; Center declares level). Degraded radio: prioritize emergency traffic; crews acknowledge on fallback, repeat location/destination; if voice fails, dispatchers shall use approved data channel and log every attempt; after restoration reconcile delayed reports, preserve discrepancies. Mutual aid when objectives missed. Shift handover: incoming shift verifies before accepting; Shift Commander keeps authority until named successor acknowledges. Actors: Call Taker Mara (Larkspur): produces Caller Location Correction Slip, receives Bedside Arrival Receipt. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield): sets priority, sends Pediatric Acuity Note, approves overrides, reviews Duplicate Incident Audit Memo and acuity/escalation risk cases. Regional Medical Director: clinical policy; approves guidance changes; reviews significant events with Shift Commander. Dispatcher: recommends units. Shift Commander (Sundial): approves exceptions, sends Mutual Aid Release Form, receives Coverage Gap Bulletin, may restrict capability for unacceptable defect risk. Radio Coordinator (Mistral): uses Regional Radio Network, Unit Staging Change Card, South Access Lane Notice; sends Coverage Gap Bulletin. Paramedic Crew: reports status. Hospital Liaison Desk (Kestrel): confirms capacity, produces Bedside Arrival Receipt. Fleet Maintenance Cell (Bluejay): produces Battery Swap Voucher, uses Mutual Aid Release Form, schedules preventive work, keeps maintenance records (asset, work, parts, return-to-service). Data Quality Officer (Pebble): sends Duplicate Incident Audit Memo. Systems: Computer Aided Dispatch Console (scenario-tested before change authorized); Ambulance Coordination Platform (queues updates; changes impact-assessed; monitored); North/South Gate Status Boards; Ambulance Unit 417. Rules: radio network rechecked after changes; release records owner, tests, limitations, rollback; findings assigned owner, due date, closure verification; corrective actions verified for effectiveness.

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
